hypotheses.title: Unintended Data Exposure
hypotheses.description: The system may expose sensitive data to unauthorized users due to a misconfigured access control mechanism.
hypotheses.recommendedNextStep: Review access control configuration and implement additional security measures to prevent data exposure.

hypotheses.title: Privilege Escalation
hypotheses.description: An attacker may exploit a vulnerability in the system to gain elevated privileges and access sensitive data.
hypotheses.recommendedNextStep: Conduct a thorough security audit to identify and address potential vulnerabilities in the authentication module.
